name: cbb-sabermetrics
description: Live NCAA Division I college baseball through the Blaze Sports Intel MCP: scoreboard, standings, Top 25 rankings, player stats, team schedules, game detail and BSI article search, plus advanced metrics worked from the box score.

interface.shortDescription: Live NCAA DI college baseball sabermetrics via Blaze Sports Intel MCP
interface.longDescription: Query live Division I college baseball through the Blaze Sports Intel MCP server at https://sabermetrics.blazesportsintel.com/mcp: the daily scoreboard, conference standings, Top 25 rankings, player stats, team schedules, full game detail and a search across BSI articles. Advanced metrics (wOBA, wRC+, FIP, BABIP, ISO) are worked from the box score with the formulas in the skills. Free, 30 requests a minute, no API key.
interface.defaultPrompt: Pull the current SEC standings and this week's Top 25.
